ModMetaData.name: VFE Insectoids 2 (HSK/CE Patched)
ModMetaData.author: Oskar Potocki, xrushha, Taranchuk, Sarg Bjornson — HSK/CE patch by CarbineAction
ModMetaData.description:
HSK/CE-patched version of Vanilla Factions Expanded - Insectoids 2, tuned for the Hardcore SK modpack.
Original mod by Oskar Potocki, xrushha, Taranchuk, Sarg Bjornson. This patch version rebalances ingredients to HSK's refined-metal economy and bundles the community-made CE compatibility patches.
--- HSK-NATIVE TUNING ---
THUMPERS (boss-summoning devices) — all 5 Thumpers upgraded from base Steel+ComponentIndustrial to HSK hardcore pricing with Mechanism + ComponentSpacer + InsectJelly ingredients. Justifies their power as endgame boss summons.
SHIP DEBRIS (InfestedShipChunk/Part/Module) — Steel refs swapped to SteelBar (HSK refined metal) with 1:5 scaling since HSK "Steel" is raw iron ore, SteelBar is refined.
INSECTJELLY BUILDINGS — costs adjusted where appropriate to fit HSK's gated-crafting economy.
--- PRESERVED ---
Full Insectoid gameplay: - 25 insect races (Empress, Queen, Titantick, Teramantis, Gigamite, Silverfish, etc.) - Custom architect tab (VFEI2_Insectoids) with all hive buildings - Research tree (Insectoid-specific projects) - Pherocore extraction + 5 species-specific hives - Quest scripts, scenarios, faction content
--- BUNDLED CE PATCHES ---
Community-made HSK CE patches (originally at G:\HSK CE patches\VFE Insectoids 2\) bundled and gated by IfModActive="CETeam.CombatExtended" in LoadFolders.xml. Covers: - All 25 race CE stats (armor, health, attack) - Building CE stats (walls, pods) - Insect leather CE stats - Ability damage defs
--- COMPATIBILITY ---
Requires: HSK (skyarkhangel.hsk), Combat Extended (CETeam.CombatExtended), Harmony, VE Framework. NOT compatible with original "OskarPotocki.VFE.Insectoid2" — enable this INSTEAD.
